   1 class_name EffectSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func sub_systems() -> Array[Array]:
   9 	return [[q.with_all([C_Effect, C_Visual]).enabled(), _effects], [q.with_all([C_Projectile]).enabled(), _projectiles], [q.with_all([C_Hitbox]).enabled(), _hitboxes]]
  10 
  11 func _effects(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var effect: C_Effect = entity.get_component(C_Effect)
  16 		effect.remaining = maxf(0.0, effect.remaining - delta)
  17 		var visual: C_Visual = entity.get_component(C_Visual)
  18 		var ratio: float = effect.remaining / maxf(effect.duration, 0.001)
  19 		visual.tint.a = effect.color.a * (1.0 if effect.kind.ends_with("warning") else ratio)
  20 		if is_instance_valid(visual.node):
  21 			if effect.kind == "ghost_hand":
  22 				visual.node.position.y = lerpf(-25.0, 150.0, pow(1.0 - ratio, 4.0))
  23 				visual.node.rotation = sin((1.0 - ratio) * PI) * 0.16
  24 			elif not effect.kind.ends_with("warning"):
  25 				visual.node.scale = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + (1.0 - ratio) * 0.25)
  26 		if effect.remaining <= 0.0:
  27 			runtime.request_removal(entity.id)
  28 
  29 func _projectiles(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  30 	for entity in entities:
  31 		if not entity.enabled:
  32 			continue
  33 		var projectile: C_Projectile = entity.get_component(C_Projectile)
  34 		projectile.remaining = maxf(0.0, projectile.remaining - delta)
  35 		if projectile.consumed or projectile.remaining <= 0.0:
  36 			runtime.request_removal(entity.id)
  37 
  38 func _hitboxes(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  39 	for entity in entities:
  40 		if not entity.enabled:
  41 			continue
  42 		var hitbox: C_Hitbox = entity.get_component(C_Hitbox)
  43 		hitbox.active_left = maxf(0.0, hitbox.active_left - delta)
  44 		if hitbox.active_left <= 0.0:
  45 			runtime.request_removal(entity.id)
